event GameCompleted(address indexed winner, uint256 indexed prizeAmount, uint256 indexed timestamp)
event PlacedBet(uint256 indexed betId, address indexed bettor, uint256 indexed amount, address token, uint256 timestamp)
event RoleAdminChanged(bytes32 indexed role, bytes32 indexed previousAdminRole, bytes32 indexed newAdminRole)
event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender)
event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender)
function bet(uint256 nftId, uint256 amount, address referral)
function bets(uint256) view returns (address bettor, uint256 amount, uint256 timestamp)

function changeConfig((address factory, address team, address foundation, address nextVault, address holdersVault, address nftWinner, address lastBettor, uint256 totalBets, uint256 nextBetAt, bool isFinalized) config)
function changePrize((uint256 prizePool, uint256 winner, uint256 nexts, uint256 patron, uint256 holders, uint256 team, uint256 foundation, uint256 next, uint256 holder) prize)

function getEarners() view returns (address[], uint256[], uint256[], uint256[])

function getTimestamps() view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256)
function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) view returns (bool)

function initialize(address deployer, (address token, address patron, address nft, uint256 nftId, address prizeNft, uint256 prizeNftId, uint256 minAmount, uint256 initPrize, uint256 startTime, uint256 endTime, uint32 interval, uint16 betPerc, uint16 refPerc, uint16 winnerPerc, uint16 nextsPerc, uint16 patronPerc, uint16 holdersPerc, uint16 teamPerc, uint16 foundationPerc, uint16 maxNexts, uint16 maxHolders, bool autoFinalize, bool poolBalReq, bool isFixedPrize, string uri) setting)
